writtenTo: All people — that they may believe
importantNotes: John 3:16 is the most well-known verse in the Bible.
The seven 'I AM' statements reveal Jesus' divine identity (bread, light, door, shepherd, resurrection, way, vine).
John's Gospel is 90% unique material not found in the other Gospels.
John 20:31 states the purpose: 'that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ.'
The Upper Room Discourse (chs. 13-17) contains Jesus' most intimate teaching.

chapters.1: In the beginning was the Word; John the Baptist's witness; calling of the first disciples.
chapters.2: The wedding at Cana — water turned to wine; Jesus cleanses the Temple.
chapters.3: Nicodemus — 'you must be born again'; John 3:16; John the Baptist's final testimony.
chapters.4: The Samaritan woman at the well; 'God is spirit'; healing the official's son.
chapters.5: Healing at the Pool of Bethesda on the Sabbath; Jesus claims equality with God.
chapters.6: Feeding the 5,000; walking on water; 'I am the bread of life'; many disciples leave.
chapters.7: Jesus at the Feast of Tabernacles; 'rivers of living water'; divided opinions about Him.
chapters.8: The woman caught in adultery; 'I am the light of the world'; 'Before Abraham was, I AM.'
chapters.9: Healing the man born blind; the Pharisees investigate; spiritual blindness.
chapters.10: 'I am the good shepherd'; 'I and the Father are one'; they try to stone Jesus.
chapters.11: The death and raising of Lazarus; 'I am the resurrection and the life.'
chapters.12: Mary anoints Jesus; the triumphal entry; Jesus predicts His death; the grain of wheat.
chapters.13: Jesus washes the disciples' feet; the new commandment to love; Judas leaves.
chapters.14: 'I am the way, the truth, and the life'; the promise of the Holy Spirit (Comforter).
chapters.15: 'I am the vine, you are the branches'; 'love one another as I have loved you.'
chapters.16: The Holy Spirit's work; grief will turn to joy; 'I have overcome the world.'
chapters.17: Jesus' High Priestly Prayer — for Himself, His disciples, and all future believers.
chapters.18: Arrest in the garden; Peter's denial; trial before Annas, Caiaphas, and Pilate.
chapters.19: Jesus scourged and crowned with thorns; crucifixion; 'It is finished'; burial.
chapters.20: The empty tomb; Mary Magdalene meets the risen Jesus; Thomas believes — 'My Lord and my God!'
chapters.21: Breakfast by the Sea; Jesus reinstates Peter — 'Feed my sheep'; the beloved disciple.
